Product Description

A high-quality wafer kit designed for servicing. The KeyDIY 12-Piece Welding-Free Clamp Adapter Set is a professional accessory kit designed to simplify transponder cloning and chip data collection when using the KeyDIY KD-X4 and KD-MAX.

These specialised adapters allow automotive locksmiths to securely connect to a variety of transponder chips and smart key circuit boards without soldering or welding. By clamping directly onto the chip or PCB, the adapters enable data reading, cloning and transponder generation procedures while reducing the risk of damaging expensive keys and electronic components.

Supporting a wide range of transponder and smart key types, including ID46, 5C, 5D, Audi 5D, Porsche 5D, BMW BDC2 and BDC3 systems, this complete 12-piece kit ensures you have the correct adapter for many of the most common cloning and data acquisition jobs encountered in the workshop.

title: XHORSE XDMQBAGL MQB Adapter
description:
Simplified Key Addition Without Dashboard Disassembly

Product Overview:

The XHORSE XDMQBAGL MQB Adapter is a revolutionary tool designed for effortless key programming for most MQB48 keys, without the need to disassemble the vehicle’s dashboard. By only removing the key and connecting two wires, this adapter offers a simple, low-risk method for adding keys. When paired with the VVDI MLB Tool, it ensures a seamless key data reading experience for MQB48 key systems.

Key Features:

  • No Dashboard Removal: There’s no need to dismantle the dashboard. Simply remove the key and solder two wires for easy key programming.
  • Simplified Key Addition: With minimal steps and low risk, this adapter makes it easier to read key data and add new keys.
  • Optimized for Computer Use: For best results, it is recommended to collect data using a computer instead of a tablet.
  • Compatible with VVDI Tools: Works smoothly with VVDI Key Tool Plus or VVDI2 (with MQB48 function enabled) to effortlessly complete key data reading and key generation.

How It Works: (User Guide)

For VVDI2 Device:

  1. Connect the MLB device + MQB adapter to read IMMO data from the MQB48 key.
  2. Load the IMMO data onto the VVDI2 tool to generate and learn the key (MQB function must be enabled on VVDI2; no MQB48 NEC35XX locking function needed).

For KEY TOOL PLUS / KEY TOOL MIDI Device:

  1. Directly connect the tablet device to the MLB device + MQB adapter to read IMMO data from the MQB48 key.
  2. Load the IMMO data onto the tablet device to generate and learn the key (fourth-generation authorization required; no MQB48 NEC35XX locking function needed).

Package Contents:

  • 1 x XHORSE XDMQBAGL MQB Adapter

With its easy setup and ability to avoid disassembling the dashboard, the XHORSE XDMQBAGL MQB Adapter is the ideal solution for quick, efficient key programming for MQB48 systems.

A high-quality, second-generation BCM2 solder-free adaptor set designed for adding keys and recovering all-lost key situations on Audi vehicles. This upgraded kit delivers a faster, safer, and completely solder-free workflow, ideal for professional automotive locksmiths who value reliability and efficiency.

The BCM2 2nd Gen set works seamlessly with Xhorse Key Tool Plus, VVDI2, and VVDI Prog, ensuring smooth integration across your existing Xhorse ecosystem. Built with proven performance and extended compatibility, it’s an essential tool for any modern workshop.

Key Features

  • No soldering required — perform all-key-lost operations without advanced soldering skills.
  • No need for VW server connection — save time and expense by computing data locally.
  • Read BCM2 IMMO data even without the original key ID.
  • Supports 5th-generation IMMO systems for modern Audi BCMs.
  • Full-series BCM2 coverage — supports 03XX / 04XX / 05XX / 06XX / 07XX / 08XX BCM2 versions.
  • Read/write PFLASH + DFLASH directly without disassembly, reducing time and risk.
  • Compatible with VVDI Key Tool Plus Pad, VVDI2 + VVDI Prog.
  • Free online updates like other Xhorse tools.
  • Uses standard 754J keys available on the market for programming.
  • Easy to use — plug, connect, and operate with confidence.

Supported Vehicles

  • Audi A4L, A5, Q5 (2013–2019) — BCM2 versions 0711, 0650, 0641 (supports add key & all keys lost).
  • Audi A6L, A7, A8 (2013–2019) — BCM2 versions 0825, 0824, 0827 (supports IMMO data retrieval when all keys are lost).
  • Also supports the wider 03XX → 08XX BCM2 series and 5th-generation IMMO systems across applicable models.

Package Includes

  • 1 × BCM2-A Solder-Free Adapter
  • 1 × BCM2-B Solder-Free Adapter
  • 1 × Adapter Cable for VVDI Key Tool Plus
  • 1 × Adapter Cable for MULTI-PROG

title: OEM Steering Transceiver Coil Ignition Antenna – Immobiliser Receiver Ford BK2T15607AC
description:
OEM Steering Transceiver Coil Ignition Antenna designed for reliable immobiliser signal transmission on selected Ford vehicles fitted with the 2.2 TDCi engine.

This immobiliser receiver is mounted around the ignition barrel and communicates directly with the vehicle’s immobiliser system. It features a 4-pin plug and is manufactured to OEM specification, making it suitable for professional auto locksmiths and vehicle repair specialists.

Vehicle Compatibility (ID63 Systems)

  • Ford Transit Mk8 2013-2019
  • Ford Transit Custom Mk1 2012-2018
  • Ford Tourneo Custom Mk1 2012-2018

What This Part Does

The steering transceiver coil reads the transponder chip inside the vehicle key when it is inserted into the ignition. It then sends this information to the immobiliser control unit.
If the correct signal is received, the immobiliser is disengaged and the engine is allowed to start.   A faulty transceiver coil can cause non-start issues, immobiliser warning lights, or keys not being recognised.

What’s Included

  • 1 x Steering Transceiver Coil Ignition Antenna
  • OEM Part Numbers:  BK2T-15607-AC/ BK2T15607AC/ BK2T-15607-AB/ BK2T15607AB/ 1825185/ 1781892

title: OEM Steering Transceiver Coil Ignition Antenna – Immobiliser Receiver for Ford GK2T15607AA
description:
OEM Steering Transceiver Coil Ignition Antenna designed for reliable immobiliser signal transmission on selected Ford vehicles fitted with the 2.0 TDCi/EcoBlue and 2.2 TDCi engines.

This immobiliser receiver is mounted around the ignition barrel and communicates directly with the vehicle’s immobiliser system. It features a 4-pin plug and is manufactured to OEM specification, making it suitable for professional auto locksmiths and vehicle repair specialists.

Vehicle Compatibility (ID47 Systems)

  • Ford Transit Custom 2018-2024
  • Ford Tourneo 2016-2022

What This Part Does

The steering transceiver coil reads the transponder chip inside the vehicle key when it is inserted into the ignition. It then sends this information to the immobiliser control unit.
If the correct signal is received, the immobiliser is disengaged and the engine is allowed to start.   A faulty transceiver coil can cause non-start issues, immobiliser warning lights, or keys not being recognised.

What’s Included

  • 1 x Steering Transceiver Coil Ignition Antenna
  • OEM Part Numbers:  GK2T-15607-AA/ GK2T15607AA/  2013324

title: OEM Steering Transceiver Coil Ignition Antenna – Immobiliser Receiver for Ford 8A6T-15607-AC
description:
OEM steering transceiver coil ignition antenna designed for reliable immobiliser signal transmission on selected Ford vehicles fitted with standard Ford PATS transponder systems.

The immobiliser receiver mounts around the ignition barrel and communicates directly with the vehicle’s immobiliser system. Featuring a 4-pin connector, it is manufactured to OEM specification and is suitable for professional auto locksmiths and vehicle repair specialists.

Vehicle Compatibility (PATs Systems)

  • Ford B-Max 2012–2017
  • Ford Fiesta Mk7 2013–2017
  • Ford EcoSport 2014–2017

What This Part Does

The steering transceiver coil reads the transponder chip inside the vehicle key when it is inserted into the ignition and sends this information to the immobiliser control unit. If the correct signal is received, the immobiliser is disengaged and the engine is allowed to start.

A faulty transceiver coil can cause:

  • Non-start conditions
  • Immobiliser warning light
  • Keys not being recognised

What’s Included

  • 1 x Steering Transceiver Coil Ignition Antenna
  • OEM Part Numbers:  8A6T-15607-AC/ 8A6T15607AC/

title: Lock50 JLR HW04-C Toolkit Enhanced Version (Anytime Use)
description:
The HW04-C is an advanced key programming and diagnostics toolkit specifically designed for Jaguar and Land Rover vehicles from 2017 to 2024+. This professional-grade solution enables locksmiths and automotive specialists to efficiently add and remove keys, program new RFAs, and work with both locked and unlocked security modules.

HW04-C is a professional-grade solution that handles locked modules, advanced key duplication, and supports newer models more robustly.

Key Addition: SW28 Special Function - worth £2000

As part of this package, the HW04-C includes the SW28 special function—an unlimited use upgrade. This function enables RFA replacement without the need to replace the BCM, even on vehicles with the latest post-2021 software updates. SW28 bypasses limitations caused by updated BCM firmware, ensuring seamless immobilizer programming on newer JLR models.

This addition eliminates one of the biggest limitations faced by professionals working on the latest JLR models, enabling quick and efficient work.

Key Features:

  • Key Programming & Module Replacement – Program new RFA modules, even when the existing module is locked.
  • Quick Key Addition/Removal – Effortlessly add or remove keys when working with an unlocked RFA.
  • Vehicle Compatibility – Designed for Jaguar & Land Rover models from 2017 to 2024+.
  • Cost-Efficient – Reduces dealership dependency by providing direct programming solutions.
  • Remote Support – Includes TeamViewer assistance for guided key programming and troubleshooting.

Free Features Included:

  • SW01 - SW02: Read Jaguar Land Rover PCF7953 & NCF29A Key Frequency & Locked Status.
  • SW04 - SW07: Key emulation for Jaguar Land Rover MCU SPC560B60L3 modules (2017-2024+).
  • SW09 - SW14: Module key copying, MCU dumping, and key duplication for both locked & unlocked RFA/KVM modules.
  • SW20 - SW23: Diagnostics, VIN programming, and module flashing for vehicles from 2006 to 2024+.
  • SW24 - SW30: CCF Flashing, UWB/PEPS Modifications, Key Addition, and OEM UWB key support.
  • SW28 Special Function (Unlimited Use) – Enables RFA replacement without BCM swap, bypassing post-2021 immobilizer restrictions.
  • SW31 - SW37: ALARM OFF functions, key duplication, DOIP programming, and Ethernet-based diagnostics (2022-2024+).

Difference between HW04-B and HW04-C

  • Advanced Key Programming (HW04-C)
    Includes SW36 for key duplication and emergency start on locked RFAs and BCMs for 2017–2025+ PEPS UWB vehicles. Not available in HW04-B without upgrades.
  • Broader Special Function Access
    HW04-C offers a wider range of software modules (SW01–SW36), including key emulation, used key reprogramming, and advanced RFA/BCM handling. HW04-B has limited access unless upgraded.
  • Upgrade Path
    HW04-B users can upgrade to HW04-C via a software license, unlocking SW36 and additional functions. Subscription includes 12 months free, with annual fees thereafter.
  • Programming When Modules Are Locked
    HW04-C supports full keyless entry and emergency start even when the RFA or BCM is locked—unlike HW04-B.

brand: Lockpicks – Professional Auto and Residential Locksmith Tools
title: GOSO HU101 Rake Pick Tool – For Ford Inner Groove Locks
description:
A high-quality lock picking tool designed specifically for Ford vehicles, the GOSO HU101 Rake Pick is built to manipulate the internal wafer tracks of HU101 profile locks.  Commonly used in Ford door and ignition systems, this tool offers a fast and effective method for non-destructive lock entry.

Key Features:

  • Engineered for HU101 Profile Locks - Designed to work with the unique 2-track inner groove configuration found in HU101 locks used across a wide range of Ford models.
  • Quick Raking Method- The rake-style head mimics key bitting patterns through rapid movement inside the lock while applying tension. Ideal for fast and efficient operation.
  • Non-Destructive Entry Tool - Allows access to the lock without causing damage to the cylinder or surrounding components when used correctly.
  • Hardened Spring Steel Construction - Made from durable, flexible steel for repeated use and long service life, even under demanding conditions.
  • Ergonomic Grip - Fitted with a comfortable, rubber-coated handle for improved control and handling during use.
  • For Skilled Operators - Designed for use by professionals with experience in lock manipulation and wafer-based systems.

Applications:

  • Entry to HU101 profile locks
  • Practice and training on inner groove lock mechanisms
  • Suitable for use in professional auto locksmith workflows

Compatible with many Ford Models, Including:

  • Focus
  • Fiesta
  • Mondeo
  • Transit
  • Galaxy
  • Other models fitted with HU101 lock profiles

Reliable, efficient, and purpose-built for HU101 inner groove locks, this tool is a must-have for any vehicle locksmith working with Ford systems.

title: GOSO HU66 Rake Pick Tool – For VAG Group Inner Groove Locks (V1–V4)
description:
A high-quality lock picking tool designed for Volkswagen Group vehicles, the GOSO HU66 Rake Pick is built to manipulate the internal wafers of HU66 profile locks. Used across multiple generations of VW, Audi, Seat, and Skoda vehicles, this tool provides a fast and effective method for non-destructive lock entry.

Key Features:

  • Made for HU66 Profile Locks - Specifically designed for the HU66 lock system, covering generations V1 through V4. Suitable for a wide range of vehicles from the Volkswagen Audi Group (VAG).
  • Efficient Raking Technique - The rake-style head simulates key bitting through rapid in-and-out movement while applying turning tension, allowing swift and efficient entry.
  • Non-Destructive Entry Tool - Offers an effective way to manipulate the lock without causing damage when handled correctly.
  • Durable Spring Steel Construction- Manufactured from flexible, hardened steel to ensure reliable performance and a long service life under repeated use.
  • Ergonomic Handle - Fitted with a rubber-coated grip for enhanced comfort and control during operation.
  • For Skilled Users - Best suited to professionals with experience in lock picking and vehicle entry techniques.

Applications:

  • Entry to HU66 profile locks
  • Practical use in professional locksmith environments
  • Training and lock servicing involving VAG lock systems

Compatible with Many VAG Vehicles, Including:

  • Volkswagen Golf, Passat, Polo, Transporter
  • Audi A3, A4, A6
  • Seat Leon, Ibiza
  • Skoda Octavia, Superb
  • And other models using HU66 V1–V4 profile locks

Reliable, efficient, and purpose-built for the HU66 inner groove system, this rake pick is an essential addition to any auto locksmith’s toolkit working within the VAG vehicle range.

Unlock full access to diagnostics and bidirectional controls for FIAT and Chrysler vehicles with the OBD 12 + 8 Pin SGW Secure Gateway Bypass Adapter Lead Cable MK2.

This versatile adapter cable is designed to bypass the Secure Gateway Module (SGW), enabling complete communication with the vehicle's systems for advanced diagnostics, repairs, and software updates. The cable works with 12-pin and 8-pin OBD connectors, making it compatible with a wide range of vehicles.

It is specifically engineered to work with popular diagnostic tools like Autel Maxisys, Launch X431, OBDSTAR, and others, allowing access to vehicles that have a Secure Gateway Module, which blocks scan tools from performing full diagnostic tasks.

title: XHORSE XDMQBAGL MQB Adapter
description:
Simplified Key Addition Without Dashboard Disassembly

Product Overview:

The XHORSE XDMQBAGL MQB Adapter is a revolutionary tool designed for effortless key programming for most MQB48 keys, without the need to disassemble the vehicle’s dashboard. By only removing the key and connecting two wires, this adapter offers a simple, low-risk method for adding keys. When paired with the VVDI MLB Tool, it ensures a seamless key data reading experience for MQB48 key systems.

Key Features:

  • No Dashboard Removal: There’s no need to dismantle the dashboard. Simply remove the key and solder two wires for easy key programming.
  • Simplified Key Addition: With minimal steps and low risk, this adapter makes it easier to read key data and add new keys.
  • Optimized for Computer Use: For best results, it is recommended to collect data using a computer instead of a tablet.
  • Compatible with VVDI Tools: Works smoothly with VVDI Key Tool Plus or VVDI2 (with MQB48 function enabled) to effortlessly complete key data reading and key generation.

How It Works: (User Guide)

For VVDI2 Device:

  1. Connect the MLB device + MQB adapter to read IMMO data from the MQB48 key.
  2. Load the IMMO data onto the VVDI2 tool to generate and learn the key (MQB function must be enabled on VVDI2; no MQB48 NEC35XX locking function needed).

For KEY TOOL PLUS / KEY TOOL MIDI Device:

  1. Directly connect the tablet device to the MLB device + MQB adapter to read IMMO data from the MQB48 key.
  2. Load the IMMO data onto the tablet device to generate and learn the key (fourth-generation authorization required; no MQB48 NEC35XX locking function needed).

Package Contents:

  • 1 x XHORSE XDMQBAGL MQB Adapter

With its easy setup and ability to avoid disassembling the dashboard, the XHORSE XDMQBAGL MQB Adapter is the ideal solution for quick, efficient key programming for MQB48 systems.

title: Xhorse BCM2 2nd Generation Solder-Free Adaptor Set for Audi XDNPA2GL
description:
A high-quality, second-generation BCM2 solder-free adaptor set designed for adding keys and recovering all-lost key situations on Audi vehicles. This upgraded kit delivers a faster, safer, and completely solder-free workflow, ideal for professional automotive locksmiths who value reliability and efficiency.

The BCM2 2nd Gen set works seamlessly with Xhorse Key Tool Plus, VVDI2, and VVDI Prog, ensuring smooth integration across your existing Xhorse ecosystem. Built with proven performance and extended compatibility, it’s an essential tool for any modern workshop.

Key Features

  • No soldering required — perform all-key-lost operations without advanced soldering skills.
  • No need for VW server connection — save time and expense by computing data locally.
  • Read BCM2 IMMO data even without the original key ID.
  • Supports 5th-generation IMMO systems for modern Audi BCMs.
  • Full-series BCM2 coverage — supports 03XX / 04XX / 05XX / 06XX / 07XX / 08XX BCM2 versions.
  • Read/write PFLASH + DFLASH directly without disassembly, reducing time and risk.
  • Compatible with VVDI Key Tool Plus Pad, VVDI2 + VVDI Prog.
  • Free online updates like other Xhorse tools.
  • Uses standard 754J keys available on the market for programming.
  • Easy to use — plug, connect, and operate with confidence.

Supported Vehicles

  • Audi A4L, A5, Q5 (2013–2019) — BCM2 versions 0711, 0650, 0641 (supports add key & all keys lost).
  • Audi A6L, A7, A8 (2013–2019) — BCM2 versions 0825, 0824, 0827 (supports IMMO data retrieval when all keys are lost).
  • Also supports the wider 03XX → 08XX BCM2 series and 5th-generation IMMO systems across applicable models.

Package Includes

title: Lock Picking Training Vice Clamp Tension Practice Tool
description:
This Lock Picking Tension Tool is an effective and reliable tool for practicing or learning lock picking. 

It is used to apply slight pressure to the lock's core, allowing the pins to be set. Holding picks correctly is crucial for successful lock picking, as it allows for better control and precision. The working angle is also important, as it affects the ease of manipulating the lock.  With practice, individuals can gain confidence in their ability to pick locks without the need to physically hold the lock in hand.

  • Clamps tightly onto any surface with a ledge
  • Works on tables, workbenches, and other similar surfaces
  • Insert your lock and tighten it into the grip
  • Teeth prevent slipping and rejection of your lock
  • Provides a secure hold for many lock shapes
  • Lightweight and durable design, will last for years
  • Mimics a lock in a door for proper lock picking practice
  • Avoids the frustration of having to start over after a lock slips
  • Ensures a secure and stable grip for lock picking
  • Easy to use and effective for beginners and experienced locksmiths alike

title: Car Key Blade Cutting Service
description:
Car Key Cutting Services

Lost your car keys or need a spare? Our expert car key cutting service has got you covered! We provide precise and reliable key cutting for a wide range of vehicles. Whether you need a traditional transponder key or a modern remote key, we ensure a perfect match for your car's lock system.

How to Get Started:

  1. Choose Your Method: Decide if you want to have your key cut by a clear picture of the key blade or the key number (if available).
  2. Provide Vehicle Details: Contact us with your car’s make, model, and year to ensure compatibility with your vehicle.
  3. Send the Blade or Number: If using a picture, make sure it clearly shows the key blade that needs to be cut. Alternatively, provide the key number if you have it.

You can either call into our garage to have the key cut in person or send the key blade to us by post. We’ll take care of the cutting process and provide you with a precise, functional key.

Please note, the cost for key cutting does not include a new key blade, which must be purchased separately.

Reach out today for fast, affordable, and reliable car key cutting services!

title: OEM Steering Transceiver Coil Ignition Antenna – Immobiliser Receiver Ford BK2T15607AC
description:
OEM Steering Transceiver Coil Ignition Antenna designed for reliable immobiliser signal transmission on selected Ford vehicles fitted with the 2.2 TDCi engine.

This immobiliser receiver is mounted around the ignition barrel and communicates directly with the vehicle’s immobiliser system. It features a 4-pin plug and is manufactured to OEM specification, making it suitable for professional auto locksmiths and vehicle repair specialists.

Vehicle Compatibility (ID63 Systems)

  • Ford Transit Mk8 2013-2019
  • Ford Transit Custom Mk1 2012-2018
  • Ford Tourneo Custom Mk1 2012-2018

What This Part Does

The steering transceiver coil reads the transponder chip inside the vehicle key when it is inserted into the ignition. It then sends this information to the immobiliser control unit.
If the correct signal is received, the immobiliser is disengaged and the engine is allowed to start.   A faulty transceiver coil can cause non-start issues, immobiliser warning lights, or keys not being recognised.

What’s Included

  • 1 x Steering Transceiver Coil Ignition Antenna
  • OEM Part Numbers:  BK2T-15607-AC/ BK2T15607AC/ BK2T-15607-AB/ BK2T15607AB/ 1825185/ 1781892

title: OEM Steering Transceiver Coil Ignition Antenna – Immobiliser Receiver for Ford GK2T15607AA
description:
OEM Steering Transceiver Coil Ignition Antenna designed for reliable immobiliser signal transmission on selected Ford vehicles fitted with the 2.0 TDCi/EcoBlue and 2.2 TDCi engines.

This immobiliser receiver is mounted around the ignition barrel and communicates directly with the vehicle’s immobiliser system. It features a 4-pin plug and is manufactured to OEM specification, making it suitable for professional auto locksmiths and vehicle repair specialists.

Vehicle Compatibility (ID47 Systems)

  • Ford Transit Custom 2018-2024
  • Ford Tourneo 2016-2022

What This Part Does

The steering transceiver coil reads the transponder chip inside the vehicle key when it is inserted into the ignition. It then sends this information to the immobiliser control unit.
If the correct signal is received, the immobiliser is disengaged and the engine is allowed to start.   A faulty transceiver coil can cause non-start issues, immobiliser warning lights, or keys not being recognised.

What’s Included

  • 1 x Steering Transceiver Coil Ignition Antenna
  • OEM Part Numbers:  GK2T-15607-AA/ GK2T15607AA/  2013324

title: OEM Steering Transceiver Coil Ignition Antenna – Immobiliser Receiver for Ford 8A6T-15607-AC
description:
OEM steering transceiver coil ignition antenna designed for reliable immobiliser signal transmission on selected Ford vehicles fitted with standard Ford PATS transponder systems.

The immobiliser receiver mounts around the ignition barrel and communicates directly with the vehicle’s immobiliser system. Featuring a 4-pin connector, it is manufactured to OEM specification and is suitable for professional auto locksmiths and vehicle repair specialists.

Vehicle Compatibility (PATs Systems)

  • Ford B-Max 2012–2017
  • Ford Fiesta Mk7 2013–2017
  • Ford EcoSport 2014–2017

What This Part Does

The steering transceiver coil reads the transponder chip inside the vehicle key when it is inserted into the ignition and sends this information to the immobiliser control unit. If the correct signal is received, the immobiliser is disengaged and the engine is allowed to start.

A faulty transceiver coil can cause:

  • Non-start conditions
  • Immobiliser warning light
  • Keys not being recognised

What’s Included

title: Xhorse VVDI XZPG00EN Universal Smart Remote for Peugeot/Citroen/DS
description:
The Xhorse XZPG00EN is a specialized 3-button smart key PCB board designed exclusively for Peugeot, Citroen, and DS vehicles. Part of Xhorse's XZ Series, this PCB supports key regeneration and reuse, offering a cost-effective solution for automotive locksmiths.

This PCB board is compatible with various Xhorse VVDI tools, including:

  • VVDI Key Tool
  • VVDI Mini Key Tool
  • VVDI2
  • VVDI Key Tool Max
  • VVDI Key Tool Plus

Please note that this PCB board is designed exclusively for Peugeot, Citroën, and DS models and cannot be used for any other vehicle brands. Ensure your remote database is updated to V308 or above for optimal functionality.

  • 3 Button Remote with Lock, Unlock, Boot
  • VA2 Emergency Blade Included
  • CR2032 Battery

Tested: Peugeot 2008 2020 worked

title: Xhorse VVDI ELV/ELS Emulator for Mercedes w204 w207 w212
description:
This Simulator is an direct replacement for the original EVL/ESL and can be rewritten to another vehicle. The ESL emulator is used for w204 w207 and w212 vehicles . It will need to be programmed and can be done easily with the XHorse MB Tool via OBD 

Mercedes ELV/ESL fail because either the motor fails or the NEC locks. Both can be repaired using XHorse MB Tool, but this is not an easy task and can be very time consuming because you have to strip down an ESL.
